name: Rasumi
source:
A cheerful and cute looking girl who crosses the heroine's path. The first time they meet, she acts like a close friend. She is trusted at first, but soon appears to be different. Is she a friend or enemy?

[From the [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/rasumi.html]official website[/url]]
